The '''N-101 Nemesis droid''' was a model of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was produced by the company [[Trang Robotics]]. They were equipped with [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] generators and [[laser array]]s and they could collapse themselves into small units, roughly a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] in length. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] could also assume a stealth posture, in which they resembled [[Harvester beetle/Legends|harvester beetles]]. Parts from an N-101 Nemesis [[Droid/Legends|droid]] were stored in the armory of the resistance base [[Mountain Home]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]] and in about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Technician/Legends|mech-tech]] [[Geri]] used them to augment the defenses of the droid [[I-5YQ]].
